summaries.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of Women Veterans Recognition Day and recognizes the contributions, sacrifices, and achievements of women veterans.

title: Honoring the unbreakable spirit, bravery, and legacy of women veterans and supporting recognition of "Women Veterans Recognition Day".
